summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Yatra Sathi Complaint Portal feature complete. All 22 pytest backend tests passed (KYC validation, complaint create/list/photo/stats, admin auth/PIN, SMS log, SOS, AI tip). All 9 Playwright UI flows passed including KYC modal validation, KYC -> user-bar reveal, 8-button horizontal bottom nav (was previously broken — verified fixed), complaint submission with AI-generated summary, admin PIN unlock + dashboard stats + SMS log, and 3-second SOS hold triggering POST /api/sos. Claude AI (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) integration returning real summaries within budget.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/public/app.html is 1235 lines — recommend splitting into separate JS/CSS modules for maintainability (not blocking).
Photo storage uses base64 inside MongoDB doc (capped 2MB). For scale, move to object storage (S3/GridFS) and persist only URL.
ADMIN_PIN is sent as header X-Admin-Pin in every admin call — fine for MVP but consider session token + httponly cookie for production.

/api/complaints/stats route is defined AFTER /api/complaints/{cid}/status and /api/complaints/{cid}/photo. Currently OK because 'stats' segment count differs, but consider explicit route ordering to avoid future conflicts.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed KYC, complaints (smoking + cleanliness w/photo), SOS events, SMS logs. Not auto-cleaned but harmless (prefixed for easy identification).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all current endpoints. Frontend is a static HTML at /app/frontend/public/app.html — use page.goto + localStorage.clear() to force KYC flow. All elements have data-testid. AI calls take up to 10s; allow proper waits.
